links.title: Get Exchange Status
links.description: Endpoint for getting the exchange status.

links.title: Get Exchange Schedule
links.description: Endpoint for getting the exchange schedule.

links.title: Get User Data Timestamp
links.description: There is typically a short delay before exchange events are reflected in the API endpoints. Whenever possible, combine API responses to PUT/POST/DELETE requests with WebSocket data to obtain the most accurate view of the exchange state. This endpoint provides an approximate indication of when the da…

links.title: Get Market Candlesticks
links.description: Time period length of each candlestick in minutes. Valid values: 1 (1 minute), 60 (1 hour), 1440 (1 day). Candlesticks for markets that settled before the historical cutoff are only available via `GET /historical/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks`. See [Historical Data](https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_s…

links.title: Get Trades
links.description: Endpoint for getting all trades for all markets. A trade represents a completed transaction between two users on a specific market. Each trade includes the market ticker, price, quantity, and timestamp information. Block trades are included in the response by default and identified by the `is_block_…

links.title: Get Market Orderbook
links.description: Endpoint for getting the current order book for a specific market.  The order book shows all active bid orders for both yes and no sides of a binary market. It returns yes bids and no bids only (no asks are returned). This is because in binary markets, a bid for yes at price X is equivalent to an as…

links.title: Get Multiple Market Orderbooks
links.description: Endpoint for getting the current order books for multiple markets in a single request. The order book shows all active bid orders for both yes and no sides of a binary market. It returns yes bids and no bids only (no asks are returned). This is because in binary markets, a bid for yes at price X is…

links.title: Get Series
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a specific series by its ticker.  A series represents a template for recurring events that follow the same format and rules (e.g., "Monthly Jobs Report", "Weekly Initial Jobless Claims", "Daily Weather in NYC"). Series define the structure, settlement sources, and met…

links.title: Get Series List
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about multiple series with specified filters.  A series represents a template for recurring events that follow the same format and rules (e.g., "Monthly Jobs Report", "Weekly Initial Jobless Claims", "Daily Weather in NYC"). This endpoint allows you to browse and discover a…

links.title: Get Markets
links.description: Filter by market status. Possible values: `unopened`, `open`, `closed`, `settled`. Leave empty to return markets with any status.  - Only one `status` filter may be supplied at a time.  - Timestamp filters will be mutually exclusive from other timestamp filters and certain status filters.

links.title: Get Market
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a specific market by its ticker. A market represents a specific binary outcome within an event that users can trade on (e.g., "Will candidate X win?"). Markets have yes/no positions, current prices, volume, and settlement rules.

links.title: Batch Get Market Candlesticks
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving candlestick data for multiple markets.

links.title: Get Event Candlesticks
links.description: End-point for returning aggregated data across all markets corresponding to an event.

links.title: Get Events
links.description: Get all events. This endpoint excludes multivariate events. To retrieve multivariate events, use the GET /events/multivariate endpoint. All events are accessible through this endpoint, even if their associated markets are older than the historical cutoff.

links.title: Get Multivariate Events
links.description: Retrieve multivariate (combo) events. These are dynamically created events from multivariate event collections. Supports filtering by series and collection ticker.

links.title: Get Event Fee Changes
links.description: Event fees are an override layered on top of the parent series' fee structure. If `fee_type_override` and `fee_multiplier_override` are null, that indicates the override is cleared.

links.title: Get Event
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about an event by its ticker. An event represents a real-world occurrence that can be traded on, such as an election, sports game, or economic indicator release. Events contain one or more markets where users can place trades on different outcomes. All events are accessible…

links.title: Get Event Metadata
links.description: Endpoint for getting metadata about an event by its ticker.  Returns only the metadata information for an event.

links.title: Get Event Forecast Percentile History
links.description: Endpoint for getting the historical raw and formatted forecast numbers for an event at specific percentiles.

links.title: Get Orders
links.description: Restricts the response to orders that have a certain status: resting, canceled, or executed. Orders that have been canceled or fully executed before the historical cutoff are only available via `GET /historical/orders`. Resting orders will always be available through this endpoint. See [Historical D…

links.title: Get Order
links.description: Endpoint for getting a single order.

links.title: Get Queue Positions for Orders
links.description: Endpoint for getting queue positions for all resting orders. Queue position represents the number of contracts that need to be matched before an order receives a partial or full match, determined using price-time priority.

links.title: Get Order Queue Position
links.description: Endpoint for getting an order's queue position in the order book. This represents the amount of orders that need to be matched before this order receives a partial or full match. Queue position is determined using a price-time priority.

links.title: Create Order (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for submitting event-market orders using the V2 request/response shape (single-book `bid`/`ask` side and fixed-point dollar prices). The legacy `/portfolio/orders` endpoint will be deprecated no earlier than May 6, 2026 — clients should migrate to this path.

links.title: Cancel All Orders
links.description: Cancels all resting event-market orders for the authenticated Direct member across every exchange shard. If `subaccount` is omitted, matching orders may come from any subaccount. If it is provided, only orders for that subaccount are eligible. Newly placed orders may also be cancelled during the min…

links.title: Batch Create Orders (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for submitting a batch of event-market orders using the V2 request/response shape. The maximum batch size scales with your tier's write budget — see [Rate Limits and Tiers](/getting_started/rate_limits).

links.title: Batch Cancel Orders (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for cancelling a batch of event-market orders using the V2 response shape. To auto-route a cancellation, provide its `market_ticker` and omit `exchange_index` or set it to `-1`. The maximum batch size scales with your tier's write budget — see [Rate Limits and Tiers](/getting_started/rate_l…

links.title: Cancel Order (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for cancelling event-market orders using the V2 response shape. To auto-route the cancellation, provide `market_ticker` and omit `exchange_index` or set it to `-1`. Returns `{order_id, client_order_id, reduced_by}` rather than a full order object.

links.title: Amend Order (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for amending the price, max fillable count, and/or expiration time of an existing event-market order. The request `count` is the updated total/max fillable count, equal to already filled count plus desired resting remaining count. This behavior matches the v1 amend endpoints; only the reque…

links.title: Decrease Order (V2)
links.description: Endpoint for decreasing the remaining count of an existing event-market order using the V2 request/response shape. Exactly one of `reduce_by` or `reduce_to` must be provided.

links.title: Get Order Groups
links.description: Retrieves all order groups for the authenticated user.

links.title: Create Order Group
links.description: Creates a new order group with a contracts limit measured over a rolling 15-second window. Users can have up to 100,000 order groups at a time. When the limit is hit, all orders in the group are cancelled and no new orders can be placed until reset.

links.title: Get Order Group
links.description: Retrieves details for a single order group including all order IDs and auto-cancel status.

links.title: Delete Order Group
links.description: Deletes an order group and cancels all orders within it. This permanently removes the group.

links.title: Reset Order Group
links.description: Resets the order group's matched contracts counter to zero, allowing new orders to be placed again after the limit was hit.

links.title: Trigger Order Group
links.description: Triggers the order group, canceling all orders in the group and preventing new orders until the group is reset.

links.title: Update Order Group Limit
links.description: Updates the order group contracts limit (rolling 15-second window). If the updated limit would immediately trigger the group, all orders in the group are canceled and the group is triggered.

links.title: Get Balance
links.description: Returns the balance and portfolio value for a member. Both values include all exchange indexes unless `exchange_index` is provided. Pass `subaccount` to use a subaccount instead of the primary account. This endpoint also accepts API keys with the 'read::portfolio_balance' scope.

links.title: Intra Account Transfer
links.description: Transfers funds within the same account.

links.title: Get Intra Account Transfers
links.description: Endpoint for fetching intra-exchange account transfer history.

links.title: Get Intra Account Transfer
links.description: Endpoint for getting a single intra-account transfer by id.

links.title: Create Subaccount
links.description: Creates a new subaccount for the authenticated user. This endpoint is available to all users on the Advanced API tier and above. Subaccounts are numbered sequentially starting from 1. Maximum 63 numbered subaccounts per user (64 including the primary account).

links.title: Transfer Between Subaccounts
links.description: Transfers funds between the authenticated user's subaccounts. Use 0 for the primary account, or 1-63 for numbered subaccounts. Set exchange_index to apply the transfer on a specific exchange shard (defaults to 0).

links.title: Get All Subaccount Balances
links.description: Gets balances for all subaccounts including the primary account.

links.title: Get Subaccount Transfers
links.description: Gets a paginated list of all transfers between subaccounts for the authenticated user.

links.title: Get Subaccount Netting
links.description: Gets the netting enabled settings for all subaccounts.

links.title: Update Subaccount Netting
links.description: Updates the netting enabled setting for a specific subaccount. Use 0 for the primary account, or 1-63 for numbered subaccounts.

links.title: Get Positions
links.description: Returns unsettled positions by default. Set `settlement_status=settled` to page through settled positions that are still in the live data set, or `settlement_status=all` for both live states. Positions already archived are available via `GET /historical/positions`. Settled and all-state positions ar…

links.title: Get Settlements
links.description: Returns settlement records still in the live data set. Archived positions are available via `GET /historical/positions`, which has different fields; this endpoint does not return archived settlement records.

links.title: Get Deposits
links.description: Endpoint for getting the member's deposit history.

links.title: Get Withdrawals
links.description: Endpoint for getting the member's withdrawal history.

links.title: Get Total Resting Order Value
links.description: Endpoint for getting the total value, in cents, of resting orders. This endpoint is only intended for use by FCM members (rare). Note: If you're uncertain about this endpoint, it likely does not apply to you.

links.title: Get Fills
links.description: Endpoint for getting all fills for the member. A fill is when a trade you have is matched. Registered partners may also use a user OAuth access token with the explicitly granted read::compliance_partner scope. Fills that occurred before the historical cutoff are only available via `GET /historical/f…

links.title: Get Target Balance Allocation
links.description: Retrieves the caller's target balance allocation across exchange indexes.

links.title: Set Target Balance Allocation
links.description: Replaces the caller's target balance allocation across exchange indexes. Percentages must total 100. Passing an empty allocations array disables automatic rebalancing.

links.title: Get Communications ID
links.description: Endpoint for getting the communications ID of the logged-in user.

links.title: Get Block Trade Proposals
links.description: Endpoint for getting block trade proposals visible to the authenticated user.

links.title: Propose Block Trade
links.description: Endpoint for creating a block trade proposal.

links.title: Accept Block Trade Proposal
links.description: Endpoint for accepting a block trade proposal.

links.title: Get RFQs
links.description: List RFQs. Pass pagination cursors back unchanged. A malformed cursor or invalid creator_user_id UUID returns HTTP 400. Use user_filter=self to filter by the authenticated user.

links.title: Create RFQ
links.description: Endpoint for creating a new RFQ. You can have a maximum of 100 open RFQs at a time.

links.title: Get RFQ
links.description: Endpoint for getting a single RFQ by id

links.title: Delete RFQ
links.description: Endpoint for deleting an RFQ by ID

links.title: Get RFQ Quote
links.description: Endpoint for getting a particular quote scoped to its RFQ.

links.title: Delete RFQ Quote
links.description: Endpoint for deleting a quote scoped to its RFQ, which means it can no longer be accepted.

links.title: Accept RFQ Quote
links.description: Endpoint for accepting a quote scoped to its RFQ. This will require the quoter to confirm.

links.title: Confirm RFQ Quote
links.description: Endpoint for confirming a quote scoped to its RFQ. This will start a timer for order execution.

links.title: Get Quotes
links.description: List quotes. The rfq_id filter requires an RFQ UUID. Pass pagination cursors back unchanged; malformed RFQ IDs or cursors return HTTP 400.

links.title: Create Quote
links.description: Endpoint for creating a quote in response to an RFQ

links.title: Get Quote
links.description: DEPRECATED: Use GET /communications/rfqs/{rfq_id}/quotes/{quote_id} instead. Endpoint for getting a particular quote.

links.title: Delete Quote
links.description: DEPRECATED: Use DELETE /communications/rfqs/{rfq_id}/quotes/{quote_id} instead. Endpoint for deleting a quote, which means it can no longer be accepted.

links.title: Accept Quote
links.description: DEPRECATED: Use PUT /communications/rfqs/{rfq_id}/quotes/{quote_id}/accept instead. Endpoint for accepting a quote. This will require the quoter to confirm.

links.title: Confirm Quote
links.description: DEPRECATED: Use PUT /communications/rfqs/{rfq_id}/quotes/{quote_id}/confirm instead. Endpoint for confirming a quote. This will start a timer for order execution.

links.title: Get API Keys
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving all API keys associated with the authenticated user.  API keys allow programmatic access to the platform without requiring username/password authentication. Each key has a unique identifier and name.

links.title: Create API Key
links.description: Endpoint for creating a new API key with a user-provided public key.  This endpoint allows users with Premier or Market Maker API usage levels to create API keys by providing their own RSA or Ed25519 public key in PEM format. The platform will use this public key to verify signatures on API requests…

links.title: Generate API Key
links.description: Endpoint for generating a new API key with an automatically created key pair.  This endpoint generates a key pair of the requested key_type (RSA when omitted). The public key is stored on the platform, while the private key is returned to the user and must be stored securely. The private key cannot…

links.title: Delete API Key
links.description: Endpoint for deleting an existing API key.  This endpoint permanently deletes an API key. Once deleted, the key can no longer be used for authentication. This action cannot be undone.

links.title: Get Account API Limits
links.description: Endpoint to retrieve the authenticated user's Predictions API usage tier and token-bucket limits. Public Predictions tiers include Basic, Advanced, Expert, Premier, Paragon, Prime, and Prestige.

links.title: Upgrade Account API Usage Level
links.description: Grants a permanent Advanced API usage-level grant. Currently only the Predictions exchange instance is supported. Criteria: at least 1 of the user's last 100 Predictions orders was created via API. Use Get Account API Limits to inspect the resulting usage tier and grants.

links.title: Get Account API Usage Level Volume Progress
links.description: Returns the authenticated user's latest cron-computed trading volume progress toward volume-based API usage tiers for the predictions (event_contract) lane. Volume figures are reported as fixed-point contract counts.

links.title: List Non-Default Endpoint Costs
links.description: Lists API v2 endpoints whose configured token cost differs from the default cost. Endpoints that use the default cost are omitted.

links.title: Get Tags for Series Categories
links.description: Retrieve tags organized by series categories.

links.title: Get Filters for Sports
links.description: Retrieve available filters organized by sport.

links.title: Get Live Data
links.description: Get live data for a specific milestone.

links.title: Get Live Data (with type)
links.description: Get live data for a specific milestone. This is the legacy endpoint that requires a type path parameter. Prefer using `/live_data/milestone/{milestone_id}` instead.

links.title: Get Multiple Live Data
links.description: Get live data for multiple milestones

links.title: Get Game Stats
links.description: Get play-by-play game statistics for a specific milestone. Supported sports: Pro Football, College Football, Pro Basketball, College Men's Basketball, College Women's Basketball, WNBA, Soccer, Pro Hockey, and Pro Baseball. Returns null for unsupported milestone types or milestones without a Sportrad…

links.title: Get Event Live Data
links.description: Get live data for an event by its event ticker. Serves event-keyed live data such as crypto price charts, commodity price timeseries, and weather observations. The `type` field in the response names the schema of the `details` object.

links.title: Get Weather Index
links.description: Get the Kalshi-computed city temperature index: the canonical minute-resolution series behind hourly temperature markets. City-keyed and independent of any event — the series exists whenever the city's index is configured. Values are Fahrenheit rounded to 0.01. Minutes where the index quorum failed…

links.title: Get Weather Index Calibrations
links.description: Get a city's published weather-index configuration timeline: the launch configuration plus every weekly offset calibration and methodology update, ascending by effective time. Each record carries the station weights, station offsets (Celsius), and the city reference used to compute index values from…

links.title: Get Structured Targets
links.description: Page size (min: 1, max: 2000)

links.title: Get Structured Target
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a specific structured target by its ID.

links.title: Get Milestone
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a specific milestone by its ID.

links.title: Get Milestones
links.description: Minimum start date to filter milestones. Format: RFC3339 timestamp

links.title: Get Multivariate Event Collection
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a multivariate event collection by its ticker.

links.title: Create Market In Multivariate Event Collection
links.description: Endpoint for creating an individual market in a multivariate event collection. This endpoint must be hit at least once before trading or looking up a market. Users are limited to 5000 creations per week.

links.title: Get Multivariate Event Collections
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about multivariate event collections.

links.title: Get Incentives
links.description: List incentives with optional filters. Incentives are rewards programs for trading activity on specific markets.

links.title: Get FCM Fills
links.description: Returns fills across the authenticated FCM's subtraders. Requires FCM member access.

links.title: Get FCM Orders
links.description: Endpoint for FCM members to get orders for their subtraders. This endpoint requires FCM member access level. At least one of `subtrader_id` or `client_order_ids` is required; supplying both returns only the orders matching both filters. API keys bound to a single FCM subtrader may also call this end…

links.title: List FCM Subtraders
links.description: Lists the authenticated FCM's event-contract subtraders, including accounts with no trades. Exchange metadata is asynchronous, so newly created accounts may not appear immediately. Trading block status includes firm-wide and Kalshi restrictions; fcm_trading_blocked identifies the FCM's own per-subtr…

links.title: Create FCM Subtrader
links.description: Endpoint for FCM members to create a subtrader on the event-contract exchange. The subtrader is registered on every exchange shard that knows the FCM; a shard provisioned later registers it lazily on the subtrader's first order there. Re-creating an existing subtrader returns 409.

links.title: Get FCM Subtrader Event Contract Daily Cap
links.description: Returns the event-contract daily premium cap configured for an FCM member's subtrader, together with its live utilization. Executed utilization is the net premium deployed by fills today (sells and settlements credit back); resting and pending utilization reserve open and in-flight orders at their f…

links.title: Update FCM Subtrader Event Contract Daily Cap
links.description: Sets the event-contract daily premium cap for an FCM member's subtrader. The cap bounds the subtrader's net premium at risk per trading day. It is enforced on cap-reservation sessions — which every subtrader-bound API key uses — and is mandatory there: a subtrader with no cap cannot trade through it…

links.title: Delete FCM Subtrader Event Contract Daily Cap
links.description: Removes the event-contract daily premium cap for an FCM member's subtrader. Removal closes the subtrader to new orders on cap-reservation sessions — every subtrader-bound API key — until a cap is set again. It does not stop orders your own unbound sessions submit on the subtrader's behalf; to stop t…

links.title: Get FCM Subtrader Blocked Categories
links.description: Returns the event categories an FCM member has blocked for one of its subtraders. The subtrader must belong to the requesting FCM. A subtrader with no blocks returns an empty list.

links.title: Update FCM Subtrader Blocked Categories
links.description: Adds one event category to, or removes one from, the set an FCM member has blocked for one of its subtraders. The subtrader must belong to the requesting FCM. Blocks apply prospectively: new orders the subtrader places through its bound API credentials are rejected in markets whose event belongs to…

links.title: Get FCM Positions
links.description: Endpoint for FCM members to get market positions filtered by subtrader ID. This endpoint requires FCM member access level and allows filtering positions by subtrader ID. API keys bound to a single FCM subtrader may also call this endpoint: `subtrader_id` may be omitted and defaults to the key's boun…

links.title: Create FCM Position Transfer
links.description: Endpoint for FCM members to move a position in one market from one of their subtraders into a subtrader under their FCM's error account.

links.title: Get Historical Cutoff Timestamps
links.description: Returns the archive's cutoff timestamps. For positions, the cutoff is the backfill horizon; visibility in the historical API waits for a buffered, whole-event handoff.

links.title: Get Historical Market Candlesticks
links.description: Endpoint for fetching historical candlestick data for markets that have been archived from the live data set. Time period length of each candlestick in minutes. Valid values: 1 (1 minute), 60 (1 hour), 1440 (1 day).

links.title: Get Historical Fills
links.description: Endpoint for getting all historical fills for the member. A fill is when a trade you have is matched. API keys restricted to a subaccount return only that subaccount's fills. If supplied, `subaccount` must match the key's restriction. Registered partners may also use a user OAuth access token with t…

links.title: Get Historical Orders
links.description: Endpoint for getting orders that have been archived to the historical database. API keys restricted to a subaccount return only that subaccount's orders. If supplied, `subaccount` must match the key's restriction.

links.title: Get Historical Positions
links.description: Returns settled market positions after their event completes the live-to-historical handoff. Until then, settled positions remain available via `GET /portfolio/positions?settlement_status=settled`. The `market_positions_last_updated_ts` value on `GET /historical/cutoff` is the backfill horizon, not…

links.title: Get Historical Trades
links.description: Endpoint for getting all historical trades for all markets. Trades that were filled before the historical cutoff are available via this endpoint. Block trades are included by default and identified by the `is_block_trade` field; use the `is_block_trade` query parameter to filter by block / non-block…

links.title: Get Historical Markets
links.description: Endpoint for getting markets that have been archived to the historical database. Filters are mutually exclusive.

links.title: Get Historical Market
links.description: Endpoint for getting data about a specific market by its ticker from the historical database.

links.description: How price banding works for Kalshi margin markets

links.title: Create Margin FCM Subtrader
links.description: Endpoint for FCM members to create a margin subtrader.

links.title: Get FCM Subtrader Risk Controls
links.description: Returns the risk controls configured for an FCM member's subtrader on the margined exchange: the FCM-set initial margin caps in `risk_controls`, and the admin-set notional value risk limits in `notional_limits` — one call returns the subtrader's complete limit picture. A cap with neither market_tick…

links.title: Update FCM Subtrader Risk Controls
links.description: Sets the initial margin cap for an FCM member's subtrader on the margined exchange.

links.title: Delete FCM Subtrader Risk Controls
links.description: Removes the initial margin cap for an FCM member's subtrader on the margined exchange.

links.title: Update FCM Notional Risk Limit
links.description: Sets the calling FCM member's own account-level notional value risk limit on the margined exchange. The limit is stored separately from the limit Kalshi administration sets on the same account; the exchange accepts any value and always enforces the smaller of the two, so this value can tighten but n…

links.title: Delete FCM Notional Risk Limit
links.description: Clears the calling FCM member's own account-level notional value risk limit on the margined exchange. Any limit Kalshi administration has set on the account remains in force; clearing the member-set value never cancels resting orders, since it can only raise the effective limit.

links.title: Get Perps Account API Limits
links.description: Endpoint to retrieve the Perps (margin) API tier limits associated with the authenticated user.

links.title: Get Exchange Status
links.description: Endpoint for getting the margin exchange status.

links.title: Get Enabled Status
links.description: Endpoint for checking if margin trading is enabled for the authenticated user.

links.title: Get Risk Parameters
links.description: Returns system-wide margin risk parameters including liquidation thresholds and per-market initial margin multipliers.

links.title: Get Notional Risk Limit
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the notional value risk limits for the authenticated margin user. Direct members and FCM members may read their own account's limits. For an FCM member the account-level limit covers the whole omnibus account: exposure across all client accounts is aggregated against it.

links.title: Get Risk
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving leverage and liquidation price data for the authenticated direct margin user. Returns account-level leverage plus per-position leverage and liquidation prices, grouped by subaccount and market.

links.title: Get Orders
links.description: Endpoint for listing margin orders with optional filtering.

links.title: Create Order
links.description: Endpoint for submitting orders in a market.

links.title: Cancel All Orders
links.description: Cancels all resting margin orders for the authenticated Direct member. If `subaccount` is omitted, matching orders may come from any subaccount. If it is provided, only orders for that subaccount are eligible. Newly placed orders may also be cancelled during the minute after the request.

links.title: Get Order
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving a specific margin order.

links.title: Cancel Order
links.description: Endpoint for canceling an order. Cancels all remaining resting contracts and returns the canceled order details.

links.title: Decrease Order
links.description: Endpoint for decreasing the number of contracts in an existing order. Exactly one of `reduce_by` or `reduce_to` must be provided. Canceling an order is equivalent to decreasing to zero.

links.title: Amend Order
links.description: Endpoint for amending the price, max number of fillable contracts, and/or expiration time of an existing margin order.

links.title: Get Markets
links.description: Endpoint for listing available margin markets.

links.title: Get Market
links.description: Endpoint for fetching a margin market with trading stats (price, volume, open interest).

links.title: Get Market Orderbook
links.description: Endpoint for getting the orderbook for a margin market.

links.title: Get Market Candlesticks
links.description: Endpoint for fetching candlestick data for a margin market.

links.title: Get Trades
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving public margin trades across all markets or filtered by market ticker. Returns a paginated response. Use the cursor value from the previous response to get the next page.

links.title: Get Fills
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the authenticated user's margin fills. Registered partners may also use a user OAuth access token with the explicitly granted read::compliance_partner scope.

links.title: Get Positions
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the authenticated user's margin positions. Registered partners may also use a user OAuth access token with the explicitly granted read::compliance_partner scope.

links.title: Get Balance
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the balance breakdown for the authenticated direct margin user. Returns cash balance (aggregate and per-subaccount), position value, total balance, and maintenance margin requirement.

links.title: Intra Account Transfer
links.description: Endpoint for transferring funds within the same account.

links.title: Create Subaccount
links.description: Creates a new subaccount for the authenticated user in the margin exchange. Subaccounts are numbered sequentially starting from 1. Maximum 63 numbered subaccounts per user (64 including the primary account).

links.title: Transfer Between Subaccounts
links.description: Transfers funds between the authenticated user's margin subaccounts. Use 0 for the primary account, or 1-63 for numbered subaccounts.

links.title: Get Fee Tiers
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the effective margin fee rates for the authenticated direct margin user. Returns maps of margin market tickers to maker and taker fee rates as decimal fractions; no tier numbers are returned. Use Get Fee Tier Rates for the fee schedule itself.

links.title: Get Fee Tier Rates
links.description: Returns the fee schedule that applies to the authenticated margin-enabled account, as tier numbers with maker and taker fee rates ordered from the entry tier upward.

links.title: Get Funding History
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the authenticated user's historical margin funding payments joined with funding rates for a specific market, or across all markets when ticker is empty, over an inclusive UTC date range.

links.title: Get Historical Funding Rates
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving historical margin funding rates for a market, or across all markets when ticker is empty.

links.title: Get Funding Rate Estimate
links.description: Returns the estimated funding rate for the current, in-progress funding period. The value is a time-weighted average of the premium index computed over `[last_funding_time, now)`, so it continues to move as new data accumulates through the window and is only finalized at `next_funding_time`.

links.title: Get Premium Index
links.description: Returns an informational per-second premium index for a market, for a window of up to one hour. Each point is the signed fraction by which the impact-price book sat above or below the underlying index at that second, before any time weighting.

links.title: Get Order Groups
links.description: Retrieves all order groups for the authenticated user on the margin exchange.

links.title: Create Order Group
links.description: Creates a new order group on the margin exchange with a contracts limit measured over a rolling window. When the limit is hit, all orders in the group are cancelled and no new orders can be placed until reset.

links.title: Get Order Group
links.description: Retrieves details for a single order group on the margin exchange including all order IDs and auto-cancel status.

links.title: Delete Order Group
links.description: Deletes an order group on the margin exchange and cancels all orders within it.

links.title: Reset Order Group
links.description: Resets the order group matched contracts counter to zero on the margin exchange, allowing new orders to be placed again after the limit was hit.

links.title: Trigger Order Group
links.description: Triggers the order group on the margin exchange, canceling all orders in the group and preventing new orders until the group is reset.

links.title: Update Order Group Limit
links.description: Updates the order group contracts limit on the margin exchange. If the updated limit would immediately trigger the group, all orders in the group are canceled and the group is triggered.

links.title: Get Isolated Exit Triggers
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the live exit triggers on the isolated margin position for a market.

links.title: Set Isolated Exit Trigger
links.description: Endpoint for setting a stop-loss / take-profit bracket or a trailing stop on the isolated margin position for a market. Requires an open position, closes it in full, and fires reduce-only orders.

links.title: Cancel Isolated Exit Trigger
links.description: Endpoint for cancelling exit triggers on the isolated margin position for a market. Succeeds even when nothing is live. The position itself is unaffected.

links.title: Get Cross Exit Triggers
links.description: Endpoint for retrieving the live exit triggers on a non-isolated margin position.

links.title: Set Cross Exit Trigger
links.description: Endpoint for setting a stop-loss / take-profit bracket or a trailing stop on a non-isolated margin position. A position holds one trailing stop and up to 20 brackets, so long as their counts fit the position. Requires an open position unless `anchor_order_id` is supplied, and fires reduce-only order…

links.title: Cancel Cross Exit Triggers
links.description: Endpoint for cancelling exit triggers on a non-isolated margin position, including partial and order-anchored brackets. Succeeds even when nothing is live; use the `{trigger_id}` route to cancel a single bracket.

links.title: Update Cross Exit Trigger
links.description: Endpoint for updating one bracket's leg prices, leaving any others on the position untouched. At least one leg is required; cancel with `DELETE`. Trailing stops are not addressed by id — use the collection route with `kind=trailing`.

links.title: Cancel Cross Exit Trigger by ID
links.description: Endpoint for cancelling one bracket, leaving any others on the position live. Trailing stops are not addressed by id — use the collection route with `kind=trailing`.

links.title: WebSocket Connection
links.description: Main WebSocket connection endpoint. Authentication is required during the WebSocket handshake.

links.title: Connection Keep-Alive
links.description: Kalshi sends Ping frames every 10 seconds with body `heartbeat`. Clients should respond with Pong frames.

links.title: Orderbook Updates
links.description: Real-time margin orderbook price-level changes.

links.title: Market Ticker
links.description: Margin market updates are delivered on a single channel. `ticker` messages include price, top-of-book size, volume, open-interest, and optional reference/mark prices.

links.title: Public Trades
links.description: Public notifications for executed margin trades.

links.title: User Fills
links.description: Private fill notifications for the authenticated user on the margin exchange.

links.title: User Orders
links.description: Private order created/updated notifications for the authenticated user on the margin exchange.

links.title: Order Group Updates
links.description: Real-time order group lifecycle and limit updates. Requires authentication.
